_schema.note: Incremental. Cases are added one at a time and are not evidence until status is CITED. SEED cases are structural placeholders written to exercise the criterion, not observations.

cases.measured_by: residual distribution records; whether a member can inspect the book they subscribe to
cases.note: The proximity case named in the README. Q-PORT applies here first.

cases.measured_by: who books the margin on a good year; uncommitted hours per week; whether equipment finance sets the horizon
cases.note: Passes the criterion on custody and verification, fails slack and horizon. This is the case that shows the criterion covers two of five cuts.

cases.measured_by: patronage dividend versus retained earnings; member access to the ledger
cases.note: Fails the criterion on custody alone while four of five cuts are favourable. Over-rejection, the mirror of owner_operator_trucking.

cases.measured_by: royalty and supply margin as a share of unit surplus; whether the operator sees unit-level books
take rate; whether the allocation rule is inspectable by the contributor
cases.note: Verification is the cut doing the work here, not custody.

cases.measured_by: who holds the residual claim; whether the holder can inspect any node they are committed to
cases.note: Custody favourable, verification not. Tests whether the AND in the criterion is load-bearing.
